title: Other Liturgical & Sacramental Services › The Sagda Prayer (The Prostrations)

section.en: 1st: The Gospel Response, Ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ
section.path: Other Liturgical & Sacramental Services › The Sagda Prayer (The Prostrations)

text.en: This is He who is worthy of glory,

text.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ:
text.cop_lat: Je efesmaroout enje Fiot nem Psheeri:
text.en: Blessed be the Father and the Son
We worship Him and glorify Him.

text.ar: جاء الرب إلي بيت عنيا مع

section.en: 2nd: The Gospel Response, Ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ϣⲁ Ⲃⲏⲑⲁⲛⲓⲁ̀
section.path: Other Liturgical & Sacramental Services › The Sagda Prayer (The Prostrations)

text.en: He raised His hands and blessed them,

text.cop: Ⲁⲩϭ̀ⲛⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲁ̀ⲙⲁϩⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲁⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲁ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲝⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Avechnegoou empefamahi enje na-etfe nem na epkahi ni-arshee ni-eksousia nemnee etsapeseet emepkahi.
text.en: The heavenly and the earthly, the principalities and the authorities, submitted to His majesty, and those under the earth.
text.ar: خضعت لعزته السماويون والأرضيون والرؤساء والمتسلطون، وما تحت الأرض.
ونحن أيضاً نتضرع إليك يا من صعد إلي السماء لكي،

text.en: O who ascended into the heavens,

text.cop: ⲉⲑⲣⲉϥϥⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉⲧⲟϣ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲉⲟⲥ.
text.cop_lat: ethreffoti ennennovi etosh nem nenanomi-a enarsheos.
text.en: to forgive us our many sins, and our old iniquities.
the good One and Lover of mankind,
for He had compassion upon us,
and has come and saved us.

text.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ:
text.cop_lat: Je efesmaroout enje Efiot nem Psheeri:
text.en: Blessed be the Father and the Son
We worship Him and glorify Him.
The soul of the Samaritan woman /

section.path: Other Liturgical & Sacramental Services › The Sagda Prayer (The Prostrations)

text.en: who found the living water / blesses You
the dood One and Lover of Mankind,
for He had compassion on us,
and has come and saved us.

text.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀Ϣⲏⲣⲓ:
text.cop_lat: Je efesmaroout enje Fiot nem epsheeri:
text.en: Blessed be the Father and the Son
We worship Him and glorify Him.

text.cop: ⲠⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉ̀ⲥⲏⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ:
text.cop_lat: Pi-epnevma emparakleeton etafi epeseet evolkhen etfe:
text.en: The Spirit, the Paraclete that came down from the heaven
text.ar: الروح المعزي الذي نزل من السماء ظهر علي

section.path: Other Liturgical & Sacramental Services › The Sagda Prayer (The Prostrations)

text.en: appeared on the apostles on Pentecost.

text.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ ⲁⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Thoksa Patri ke I-io ke agio Epnevmati.
text.en: Glory be to the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

text.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
text.cop_lat: Ke nin ke a-i ke is tous e-onas ton e-onon ameen.
text.en: Now and forever, and unto the age of all ages. Amen
text.ar: الآن وكل اوان، وإلي دهر الداهرين آمين.

text.cop: Ⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲱ ⲡⲉⲛⲟ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅.
text.cop_lat: Enosh evol engo emmos je o penshois Ieesous Pi-ekhristos.
text.en: We cry out saying O Our Lord Jesus Christ who ascended into the heaven and sat at the right hand of His Father.
text.ar: ونصرخ قائلين يا ربنا يسوع المسيح الذي صعد الي السموات وجلس عن يمين ابيه.

text.cop: Ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲉⲓ ⲛ̀ⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲁϥϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲠⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ ⲡⲓⲠ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ.
text.cop_lat: Afshenaf e-epshei enifeeoui afhemsi saoui nam empefiot afoworp nan empiparakleeton pi-epnevma ente timethmee.
text.en: And sent us the Paraclete, the Spirit of Truth.
text.ar: وأرسل لنا البارقليط، روح الحق المعزي.

text.en: Save us and have mercy on us:

text.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲏⲥⲟⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ:
text.cop_lat: Kiri-e ele-eeson Kiri-e ele-eeson Kiri-e ele-eeson Kirie evlogeeson ameen:
text.en: Lord have mercy: Lord have mercy: Lord bless: Amen: Bless me:
text.ar: يا رب إرحم. يا رب إرحم. يا رب بارك. آمين. باركوا علي.
